# Rio Grande Children's Dentistry and Orthodontics

> A comprehensive pediatric dental and orthodontic practice in Los Lunas, New Mexico, dedicated to bringing smiles to life through specialized care for children ages 1-18.

Rio Grande Children's Dentistry and Orthodontics offers a full range of services including pediatric dentistry, orthodontics (braces and Invisalign), oral surgery, special needs dentistry, and sedation options. The practice accepts Medicaid and provides various financing options to serve families across New Mexico.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Braces & Invisalign
- Sedation Dentistry
- Special Needs Dentistry
- Medicaid Accepted
- Preventative Care
- Patient Education
- Appointment Scheduling
- Los Lunas, NM
- Oral Surgery
- Insurance & Financing
- Digital X-Rays
- Fluoride Treatment
- Patient Comfort

## Core Services

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://www.riograndechildrensdentistry.com/kid-dentistry): Pediatric dentistry services for children ages 1-18
- [Orthodontics](https://www.riograndechildrensdentistry.com/orthodontics): Orthodontic services including braces, aligners, and Invisalign
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://www.riograndechildrensdentistry.com/special-needs-dentistry): Specialized dental care for children with developmental disabilities
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://www.riograndechildrensdentistry.com/special-needs-dentistry/sedation-dentistry): Sedation dentistry options for dental anxiety and special needs
- [Oral Surgery](https://www.riograndechildrensdentistry.com/oral-surgery): Oral surgery and wisdom teeth extraction services
